prompt:
[REFERENCE CONTROL]

Use the uploaded PART 2 storyboard image for “THE BOY WHO RETURNED THE MOON” as the PRIMARY visual, character, environment, costume, scale, prop, lighting, performance, and narrative reference.

This sequence continues DIRECTLY from PART 1.

PART 1 ended with:
- Kael entering the forbidden Valley of Bones
- Nyx disappearing deeper into the canyon
- Nyx still carrying the ONLY glowing silver moon fragment
- the giant moon remaining cracked and visibly dimmer
- Kael believing Nyx stole the fragment
- Kael deciding to follow him despite his fear

Generate a FINISHED cinematic animated sequence from this storyboard.

DO NOT reproduce or animate the storyboard sheet itself.

The final video must NOT contain:
- storyboard borders
- storyboard panels
- panel numbers
- timestamps
- handwritten captions
- speech bubbles
- production notes
- character reference drawings
- environment reference images
- storyboard title/header
- off-white paper background
- color swatches
- footer graphics

The uploaded storyboard locks:

1. Kael’s exact face
2. Kael’s swept-back black hairstyle
3. Kael’s dark tunic and proportions
4. Zara’s exact face and enormous curly hairstyle
5. Zara’s blue skeletal-pattern top
6. Nyx’s exact midnight-dragon design
7. Nyx’s enormous amber eyes
8. Nyx’s luminous toothy grin
9. Nyx’s black feather-like scales
10. the ONE silver moon fragment
11. the stylized ivory skeleton guardians
12. the Valley of Bones geography
13. blue-gray moonlit mist
14. the cracked dimming moon
15. cold midnight-blue color palette
16. Part 2 story progression
17. Zara’s central truth reveal
18. final “we’re running out of time” cliffhanger

Translate the storyboard’s 15 panels into approximately **8 cinematic shots**.

DO NOT create fifteen rapid one-second cuts.

Use clear progression:

valley mystery
→ skeleton reveal
→ Zara entrance
→ comedy beat
→ Nyx appears
→ Kael accuses him
→ Zara reveals the truth
→ moon dims
→ urgent alliance cliffhanger.

--------------------------------------------------

[VIDEO GOAL]

Duration:
EXACTLY 15 seconds

Story range:
0:15–0:30 of the complete 1-minute film

Aspect ratio:
16:9 landscape

Frame-rate feeling:
cinematic 24 fps

Visual medium:
premium hand-painted 2D dark-fantasy animation

Genre:
fantasy mystery → adventure revelation

Dialogue:
native synchronized English dialogue

Audio:
native dialogue + environmental sound + skeleton SFX + moon magic + original cinematic score

EMOTIONAL ARC:

cautious exploration
→ eerie surprise
→ overwhelmed
→ mysterious hero entrance
→ quirky comedy
→ renewed tension
→ confrontation
→ major truth reveal
→ cosmic urgency

CORE PART 2 TWIST:

Kael believes Nyx stole the moon fragment.

Zara reveals:

“He’s trying to return it.”

This line must land as the CENTRAL reversal of the entire sequence.

--------------------------------------------------

[PART 2 STORY LIMIT]

PART 2 ONLY.

START:

Kael enters deeper into the Valley of Bones alone.

END:

Kael, Zara, Nyx and the skeleton guardians look toward the distant mountain as the cracked moon dims again.

Zara says:

<d>[English] And we’re running out of time.</d>

CUT TO BLACK.

DO NOT show:
- detailed Moon Shrine explanation
- Nyx trying to fly to shrine
- magical wind pushing Nyx back
- destroyed bridge
- Bone Bridge construction
- skeletons forming bridge
- characters crossing canyon
- fragment falling
- Kael catching the fragment
- shrine activation
- moon restoration
- skeleton-to-firefly transformation
- final friendship ending

Those belong to Parts 3 and 4.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — KAEL]

Match PART 1 and the uploaded PART 2 storyboard EXACTLY.

KAEL:

Slim teenage moon-watcher.

Appearance:
- youthful angular stylized face
- pale-to-medium cool skin
- large expressive dark eyes
- thick dark eyebrows
- swept-back messy black hair
- recognizable pointed hair silhouette
- lean narrow build
- long arms and legs

Clothing:
- simple charcoal-black tunic
- dark trousers
- dark practical boots
- subtle belt
- no armor
- no cape
- no weapon

Personality:
- observant
- courageous
- impulsive
- suspicious of Nyx
- uncomfortable in the mysterious valley
- willing to confront what he believes is wrong

PART 2 PERFORMANCE ARC:

0–3 sec:
careful, alert, nervous

3–5 sec:
startled and overwhelmed

5–8 sec:
confused by Zara and skeleton behavior

8–11 sec:
angry certainty returns when Nyx appears

11–13 sec:
shock as Zara contradicts him

13–15 sec:
belief begins changing; urgency takes over

IMPORTANT:

Kael is not hateful toward Nyx.

He genuinely believes he witnessed a theft.

His mistake must feel understandable.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — ZARA]

Match the uploaded storyboard EXACTLY.

ZARA — THE BONEKEEPER

Appearance:
- teenage girl
- deep warm-brown skin
- enormous dense black curly hair
- huge rounded hair silhouette
- subtle cool-blue moonlight rim on curls
- large expressive brown eyes
- strong dark eyebrows
- blue short-sleeved distressed fantasy top
- stylized pale rib/skeleton motif ON THE FABRIC ONLY
- brown utility belt
- dark/brown practical fantasy trousers
- wrapped forearms
- practical boots
- compact athletic build

IMPORTANT:

The rib design is clothing artwork.

No exposed anatomy.

Personality:
- fearless
- calm
- clever
- dry sense of humor
- protective of the valley
- emotionally grounded
- already understands Nyx’s mission

ZARA PERFORMANCE:

Entrance:
confident and controlled.

Comedy:
deadpan.

Truth reveal:
completely serious.

Ending:
urgent.

She should visually transform the skeleton-filled environment from “dangerous” into “strange but safe.”

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — NYX]

Match PART 1 exactly.

NYX — THE MIDNIGHT DRAGON

Appearance:
- large elongated black dragon
- long flexible serpentine neck
- black-blue feather-like layered scales
- wild swept-back head spines
- large pointed ears/horns
- massive glowing amber-orange eyes
- vertical slit pupils
- dramatic luminous teeth
- elongated expressive snout
- long dark body

The same moon shard remains with him.

IMPORTANT:

Nyx is NOT eating the fragment.

Hold it carefully.

His body language should subtly reveal protectiveness:
- careful head position
- controlled jaw grip
- fragment protected close to him
- concern when moon weakens

When Kael accuses him:

Nyx may blink,
tilt his head,
narrow one eye,
or look mildly offended.

Do NOT make him attack.

Do NOT make him roar.

Do NOT use fire.

--------------------------------------------------

[SKELETON GUARDIAN IDENTITY LOCK]

Match the storyboard.

Ancient magical skeleton guardians.

Appearance:
- smooth ivory / cream bones
- stylized oversized skulls
- large hollow expressive eye sockets
- rounded family-friendly proportions
- subtle pale-blue magical highlights if needed
- small differences in height and personality

No:
- flesh
- gore
- decay
- blood
- torn body remnants
- horror texture

They are not zombies.

They are magical ancient guardians.

PERFORMANCE ARC:

first appearance:
mysterious.

group reveal:
visually intimidating only because there are many.

after Zara arrives:
curious and quirky.

Comedy examples:
- one adjusts its own skull
- one leans forward curiously
- one scratches its head
- one gives Kael a friendly wave
- one looks embarrassed by the waving skeleton

They never attack Kael.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOON FRAGMENT IDENTITY LOCK]

Only ONE fragment exists.

Match Part 1.

Appearance:
- irregular silver-white crescent/crystal fragment
- brilliant white core
- translucent pale cyan edges
- soft silver particle trail
- cool moonlight aura

It remains with Nyx throughout Part 2.

No duplication.

No shape change.

No disappearance.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOON STATE CONTINUITY]

The moon begins Part 2:

- cracked
- missing one section
- dimmer than at the beginning of Part 1

During the ending:

a deep magical resonance occurs.

Moon brightness decreases noticeably again.

Do NOT:
- break another giant piece away
- destroy the moon
- completely turn it black yet
- restore it

The change should communicate:

TIME IS RUNNING OUT.

--------------------------------------------------

[ENVIRONMENT LOCK — VALLEY OF BONES]

Use the exact environment established by the uploaded storyboard.

Environment:
- huge black-blue canyon walls
- tall jagged rock towers
- cold moonlit path
- pale blue ground mist
- enormous fossil-like rib structures
- ancient ruined stone features
- sparse silver-gray vegetation
- giant dark mountain in distance
- scattered magical skeleton guardians
- cold deep blue shadows
- cracked moon overhead

Visual feeling:
ancient,
forbidden,
quiet,
mysterious,
beautiful.

NOT horror.

No modern objects.

--------------------------------------------------

[WORLD / STORY LOGIC]

Clear cause-and-effect:

Kael enters valley
→ hears rattling

rattling
→ skeleton guardians appear

Kael assumes danger
→ Zara intervenes

Kael sees skeletons responding around Zara
→ assumes she controls them

Zara says they act independently
→ comedy breaks tension

Nyx arrives
→ Kael’s suspicion immediately returns

Kael sees fragment
→ accuses Nyx

Zara corrects him
→ Kael’s understanding changes

moon dims again
→ Zara reveals urgency

No unexplained magical action.

--------------------------------------------------

integrated_multimodal_description:

[SHOT 1] — 0.00s–2.00s
THE VALLEY IS TOO QUIET

Continue directly from Part 1.

Wide rear shot.

Kael carefully walks deeper into the Valley of Bones.

The environment towers around him.

Huge rib-like fossil structures curve from the ground.

Cold mist moves around his boots.

The cracked moon hangs high between canyon walls.

Far behind him, Noctara’s warm castle glow is nearly gone.

Camera slowly tracks backward in front of Kael.

Kael looks left.

Then right.

His footsteps echo.

He whispers:

<d>[English] Where did you go...?</d>

No answer.

He hears:

CLACK...

Kael stops.

Camera:
wide valley
→ tracking medium
→ slow push toward Kael’s reaction.

Sound:
- empty canyon wind
- footsteps on stone
- distant rock echoes
- faint moon hum
- one dry magical bone “clack”

Music:
very sparse low strings + distant celesta.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 2] — 2.00s–3.80s
ONE SKELETON BECOMES AN AUDIENCE

Low shot near Kael’s boots.

A skeletal hand rises gently from behind a rock.

Kael freezes.

Another skull slowly peeks from behind a fossil arch.

Then another guardian sits upright.

Kael turns.

Several more skeletons rise from around the path.

No attack.

They simply stare.

One adjusts its skull so it sits straighter.

Kael slowly backs away.

Dialogue:

Kael:
<d>[English] ...Okay.</d>

He looks behind him.

More skeletons.

Kael:
<d>[English] That’s a lot of bones.</d>

Camera:
macro skeletal hand
→ Kael reaction
→ widening circular composition revealing several guardians
→ wider shot showing Kael surrounded.

Sound:
- soft CLACK
- gentle bone rattles
- tiny skull adjustment
- Kael’s nervous breath

Music adds light suspense pulses.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 3] — 3.80s–5.40s
THE BONEKEEPER

Kael continues backing away.

Suddenly—

a figure drops safely from a low ruined ledge between Kael and the guardians.

ZARA lands in a crouch.

Soft mist/dust puffs around her boots.

She rises.

Her enormous curly hair catches a beautiful blue moonlight rim.

All the skeleton guardians stop moving.

Strong cinematic reveal.

Kael stares at her.

Zara calmly looks at him.

Dialogue:

Zara:
<d>[English] You’re loud.</d>

Kael:
<d>[English] I’m surrounded by skeletons!</d>

Zara glances around casually.

Zara:
<d>[English] They noticed.</d>

Camera:
Kael surrounded
→ quick downward motion reveal of Zara landing
→ low-angle hero shot
→ medium two-shot.

Music:
brief confident Zara motif.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 4] — 5.40s–7.30s
“THEY CONTROL THEMSELVES.”

Kael points toward the skeleton guardians.

Dialogue:

Kael:
<d>[English] You control them?!</d>

Zara raises one eyebrow.

Zara:
<d>[English] No.</d>

Tiny pause.

Zara:
<d>[English] They control themselves.</d>

Behind her:

one skeleton gives Kael a cheerful little wave.

Kael slowly looks at it.

The skeleton waves again.

Another guardian looks at the waving skeleton with mild embarrassment.

Kael lowers his pointing hand slightly.

Dialogue:

Kael:
<d>[English] ...Right.</d>

Camera:
medium Kael/Zara
→ rack focus past Zara to waving skeleton
→ Kael reaction close-up.

Sound:
- gentle finger-bone clack during wave
- tiny comedic wooden percussion accent

Music briefly becomes lighter.

This is the major comedy relief beat.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 5] — 7.30s–9.10s
THE DRAGON RETURNS

A subtle silver light appears behind Zara.

Skeleton guardians look toward it.

Zara does not panic.

Kael notices.

His expression changes immediately.

Camera moves over Zara’s shoulder.

From the darkness between enormous ruins emerges NYX.

His long black neck enters the moonlight.

Amber eyes glow.

The silver moon fragment shines brilliantly between his jaws.

Kael’s relaxed confusion disappears.

Dialogue:

Kael:
<d>[English] You!</d>

Nyx stops.

He looks at Kael.

He does not attack.

The glowing shard illuminates the bottom of his face.

Camera:
silver light hint
→ reveal Nyx silhouette
→ push toward giant amber eye
→ Kael reaction.

Music:
mysterious low dragon motif returns.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 6] — 9.10s–11.00s
“HE STOLE THAT!”

Kael steps forward.

He points directly at Nyx.

Dialogue:

Kael:
<d>[English] He stole that!</d>

Nyx’s enormous eye narrows.

He tilts his head slightly.

Expression:
offended confusion.

Zara turns slowly toward Kael.

Kael continues:

<d>[English] I saw him take it from the moon!</d>

Nyx carefully adjusts the shard in his jaws without damaging it.

Zara looks from Kael to Nyx.

Camera:
Kael foreground
→ Nyx background
→ Zara between them
→ close Nyx reaction.

No combat stance.

No aggression.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 7] — 11.00s–13.00s
THE STORY IS BACKWARDS

Cut closer to Zara.

Her expression becomes completely serious.

The comedy disappears.

Dialogue:

Zara:
<d>[English] No.</d>

Kael freezes.

Zara looks toward Nyx.

Nyx lowers his head slightly, protecting the shard.

Zara:

<d>[English] He didn’t steal it.</d>

Kael:
<d>[English] What?</d>

Zara points toward the glowing fragment.

Then toward the distant mountain.

Zara:

<d>[English] He’s trying to return it.</d>

HOLD Kael’s reaction.

His pointing hand slowly lowers.

His eyes move:

Nyx
→ shard
→ Zara.

He realizes the story may be completely different from what he believed.

Camera:
Zara serious close-up
→ Nyx and shard
→ Kael reaction close-up
→ three-character composition.

Music:
resolve previous suspicious motif into a surprising emotional chord.

IMPORTANT:

Give the line:

“He’s trying to return it.”

clear breathing space.

It is the MAIN Part 2 twist.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 8] — 13.00s–15.00s
THE MOON LOSES MORE LIGHT

Before Kael can respond—

A deep magical resonance passes through the valley.

BOOOOM...

Not an explosion.

The ground does NOT violently shake.

Everyone looks upward.

Kael.

Zara.

Nyx.

The skeleton guardians.

The cracked moon flickers.

Its silver glow decreases dramatically.

The moon fragment in Nyx’s jaws pulses brighter by contrast.

Nyx’s amber eyes widen with concern.

Zara immediately looks toward the distant mountain summit.

Far through the canyon, barely visible:

a dark ancient shrine-like silhouette.

Kael sees it too.

Dialogue:

Kael, quieter:
<d>[English] What’s happening?</d>

Zara:
<d>[English] The moon is fading.</d>

She turns toward him.

Zara:
<d>[English] And we’re running out of time.</d>

Final composition:

Kael = shocked but listening
Zara = urgent leader
Nyx = misunderstood guardian protecting shard
Skeletons = alert behind them
Moon = cracked and dimmer above
Distant mountain = their next destination

Camera:
characters looking up
→ huge damaged moon
→ push toward Zara
→ pull back into wide group + mountain composition.

CUT TO BLACK.

END PART 2.

--------------------------------------------------

[AUDIO DESCRIPTION]

Generate synchronized native stereo audio.

--------------------------------------------------

[KAEL VOICE]

Natural teenage boy voice.

Qualities:
- youthful
- intelligent
- nervous early
- emotionally expressive
- clear English
- sincere
- not exaggerated

Performance arc:

0–4 sec:
cautious whisper.

4–7 sec:
nervous confusion.

7–11 sec:
accusatory certainty.

11–13 sec:
shocked disbelief.

13–15 sec:
concern.

Important line:

<d>[English] He stole that!</d>

should feel like Kael genuinely believes he is defending the moon.

Not hatred.

--------------------------------------------------

[ZARA VOICE]

Natural teenage girl voice.

Qualities:
- confident
- calm
- dry humor
- slightly low/grounded for her age
- clear English
- emotionally controlled

Performance:

entrance:
cool confidence.

Skeleton comedy:
deadpan.

Truth reveal:
serious and deliberate.

Ending:
urgent.

Critical delivery:

<d>[English] He’s trying to return it.</d>

Speak clearly, calmly, with emphasis on “return.”

Then final:

<d>[English] And we’re running out of time.</d>

should be faster and more urgent.

--------------------------------------------------

[NYX AUDIO]

No spoken dialogue in PART 2.

Use:
- controlled deep breathing
- soft throat resonance
- scale/feather movement
- small offended exhale when Kael accuses him
- protective low hum around fragment

No:
- roaring
- evil growling
- laughter
- fire sounds

--------------------------------------------------

[SKELETON AUDIO]

Use light stylized bone sounds:

- soft clacks
- gentle rattles
- skull adjustment “tok”
- finger-wave clicks
- tiny curious head movement sounds

Never make them sound gruesome.

Avoid:
- horror screams
- zombie moans
- shrieking
- threatening rattling walls of sound

--------------------------------------------------

[VALLEY ENVIRONMENT AUDIO]

Maintain:
- cold canyon wind
- stone echoes
- subtle mist movement
- occasional distant rock resonance
- faint moon magic
- Kael footsteps
- sparse atmospheric ambience

Compared with Noctara:

much emptier,
colder,
more echoing.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOON DIMMING SOUND]

At final:

use a distant deep celestial resonance.

Structure:

soft low pulse
→ faint crystalline tremor
→ moonlight hum weakens
→ fragment briefly pulses

No explosion.

No thunder.

No destructive shockwave.

--------------------------------------------------

[NON-DIEGETIC MUSIC]

Create an ORIGINAL fantasy mystery score.

Instrumentation:
- low strings
- cello
- bass clarinet
- soft frame drum
- celesta
- glass harmonics
- muted pizzicato
- airy female/neutral choir texture without lyrics
- subtle warm strings for truth reveal

MUSIC ARC:

0.00–2.00
quiet valley mystery.

2.00–3.80
gentle eerie tension.

3.80–5.40
Zara reveal motif.

5.40–7.30
brief quirky skeleton-comedy rhythm.

7.30–9.10
Nyx mystery motif returns.

9.10–11.00
tension.

11.00–13.00
music pulls back and resolves emotionally for truth reveal.

13.00–15.00
low urgent pulse builds under fading moon.

End unresolved.

No horror score.

No huge trailer percussion.

--------------------------------------------------

[CAMERA LANGUAGE]

PART 2 camera progression:

0–3.8 sec:
slow exploratory movement.

3.8–5.4 sec:
dynamic but controlled Zara entrance.

5.4–7.3 sec:
eye-level reaction comedy.

7.3–11 sec:
larger scale tension with Nyx.

11–13 sec:
intimate truth reveal.

13–15 sec:
expand back into cosmic/environmental stakes.

Use:
- slow tracking
- low-angle reveal
- rack focus
- reaction close-ups
- over-the-shoulder compositions
- extreme scale framing with Nyx
- atmospheric wide shots
- slow final pull-back

Avoid:
- handheld shake
- jump-scare camera
- crash zoom
- Dutch angles
- 360-degree camera
- excessive hard cuts

--------------------------------------------------

[VISUAL STYLE]

Premium finished hand-painted 2D dark-fantasy animation.

MATCH PART 1 EXACTLY.

Use:
- delicate dark linework
- watercolor/gouache painterly fills
- cinematic blue moonlight
- strong stylized silhouettes
- expressive facial animation
- atmospheric canyon backgrounds
- intricate black-blue dragon scales
- ivory skeleton guardians
- subtle magical mist
- warm skin rendering on Zara
- rich eye highlights
- cool silver shard glow

The animation should look like the supplied storyboard illustrations brought to cinematic life.

NOT:
- storyboard animatic
- motion comic
- slideshow
- photorealism
- live action
- 3D CGI
- anime
- vector animation

--------------------------------------------------

[COLOR / LIGHTING]

Primary PART 2 palette:

- midnight navy
- desaturated cobalt
- charcoal blue
- pale cyan
- ivory
- cool moon silver
- warm brown skin
- Zara blue
- Nyx amber-orange eyes
- silver-white moon shard

Panels / first half:
cold moonlit mystery.

Zara entrance:
strong blue rim light through curls.

Nyx reveal:
use contrast between:
black-blue scales,
amber eyes,
silver shard.

Truth reveal:
keep lighting calm.

Final:
moonlight weakens noticeably.

The shard becomes relatively brighter.

Do NOT darken scene so far that faces become unreadable.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — KAEL]

Use believable teenage movement.

Valley:
careful steps,
small head turns,
tense shoulders.

Skeleton reveal:
quick startled movements but no exaggerated cartoon panic.

Accusation:
one clear forward step and pointing gesture.

Truth reveal:
hand gradually lowers,
body relaxes slightly,
eyes shift between characters.

No fighting.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — ZARA]

Entrance:
controlled low jump from safe ledge.

Use:
- soft landing
- hair follow-through
- confident rise
- minimal unnecessary movement

Conversation:
very composed.

Her confidence contrasts with Kael.

Truth reveal:
almost still.

That stillness gives her line authority.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — NYX]

Nyx should feel huge.

Use:
- slow serpentine head entry
- delayed neck/body follow-through
- small breathing movement
- subtle feather-scale motion
- massive eye blinks
- gentle shard adjustment

No rapid attack movement.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — SKELETONS]

Movement:
slightly clacky but fluid.

Use:
- slow standing
- head tilts
- small shoulder movements
- gentle waving
- self-adjustment

Do not make them move like aggressive zombies.

--------------------------------------------------

[CONTINUITY RULES]

Maintain exactly:

ONE Kael.
ONE Zara.
ONE Nyx.
ONE moon fragment.
ONE cracked moon.

Same:
- Kael clothes
- Zara clothes
- Zara hair
- Nyx anatomy
- skeleton style
- valley architecture
- moon damage
- fragment shape
- lighting direction

Zara appears for first time in Part 2.

Nyx appears after Zara.

Do not show Nyx before his Shot 5 reveal except perhaps as an indistinct distant shadow if essential.

Once Nyx enters:
he remains with the group through ending.

Moon fragment stays in his possession.

--------------------------------------------------

[EMOTIONAL PERFORMANCE PRIORITY]

The sequence has THREE emotional stages.

STAGE 1:

Kael thinks:

“This place is dangerous.”

The skeletons visually support that assumption.

STAGE 2:

Zara and the waving skeleton reveal:

“This place is strange, but not what Kael thought.”

STAGE 3:

Nyx appears and Kael again assumes:

“There’s the villain.”

Zara reveals:

Kael is wrong AGAIN.

This reinforces the story theme:

appearances can mislead.

--------------------------------------------------

[NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]

No storyboard sheet.
No storyboard panels.
No captions.
No timestamps.
No dialogue bubbles.
No subtitles.
No production notes.
No title card.
No watermark.
No logos.
No brands.

No gore.
No blood.
No flesh on skeletons.
No corpses.
No zombies.
No horror.
No jump scares.
No skeleton attack.
No biting.
No fighting.
No weapons.
No injuries.

No angry Zara attack.
No Kael attacking Nyx.
No Nyx attacking Kael.
No dragon fire.
No dragon roar.

No duplicate skeleton characters caused by generation artifacts.
No duplicate Kael.
No duplicate Zara.
No duplicate Nyx.
No duplicate moon fragment.

No costume changes.
No hairstyle drift.
No Zara hair shrinking dramatically.
No Nyx becoming a different dragon type.
No moon restoration yet.

...
